game_title: Guess Until Right – Moss Door Chamber Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round, a new pickaxes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of pickaxes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
